#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
OUT="{{output_file}}-${TS}.dump"

# custom format dump (parallel-restore friendly)
pg_dump -Fc -j 4 -d {{db_name}} -f "$OUT"

# restore
# pg_restore -d {{db_name}} -j 4 --clean --if-exists "$OUT"

echo "dumped to $OUT ($(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1))"
